dedupe_keys.name: national statistical office of thailand population and housing census tables in the nso data catalogue on households by main water supply drinking water cooking fuel toilet living quarters and construction material censuses 1990 2000 and 2010 with a csv api

description: The National Statistical Office of Thailand (NSO) publishes selected results of its Population and Housing Censuses as open datasets in the NSO Data Catalogue, a CKAN portal whose resources are served as CSV from an API. The private household series covers type of living quarters, construction material, tenure, cooking fuel, toilet type, source of drinking water and main source of water supply for the whole country, split into municipal and non-municipal areas, for the 2000 and 2010 censuses; a companion indicator gives the share of households with clean drinking water for every region and province in 1990, 2000 and 2010. In 2010, 16,527,005 of 20,364,331 households used piped water as their main supply, and 14,229,060 cooked mainly with gas. Format and access: free CSV and JSON without registration; the catalogue labels them Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: the newest complete census is 2010, because the 2020 round was postponed by COVID-19 and the 2025 census has only preliminary totals; labels are in Thai and years in the Buddhist calendar; the API rejected requests without a browser user agent. Simulation uses: long-run change in piped water and fuel use for demand baselines. Related records: the Philippines 2020 census housing tables.
